name: Memory (dMemo)
description: Private, encrypted, portable long-term memory backed by 0G Storage. No cloud API key required for embedding or recall; capture never calls an LLM (infer=false always). Optional 0G Router chat inference is separate and never required for the memory leg.

privateKey.description: 0G wallet private key (0x-prefixed hex). Required. No config => memory disabled (fail-open).

scope.description: Base mem0 user_id / isolation namespace. Per-agent sessions are auto-namespaced as `<scope>:agent:<agentId>`.

network.description: 0G network the memory chain lives on.

recall.description: How memory is pulled into prompt context before each turn.

timeoutMs.description: Raised above a generic default to clear the measured cold-restore time with headroom.
